prompts.Fire: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Unity 2D pixel-art sprite layer atlas, transparent background. Reference is current faceless orange Fire slime (left cell), separate face (right cell); retain the SAME chunky stepped pixel edges, dark charcoal outlines, orange/yellow palette, simple highlight and plump silhouette. Produce a square 2x2 equal-cell transparent sprite atlas. TOP LEFT: one faceless orange slime body, completely remove the flame ornament; reconstruct a clean rounded dome, no eyes mouth blush brow or moustache, no emblem on body. TOP RIGHT: exactly one isolated red-orange flame with bright yellow center and dark outline, same flame as reference, no body, no face, centered with transparent generous margin. BOTTOM LEFT: exactly one tiny isolated orange ember particle, simple tapered diamond/flame, yellow center and orange outer edge, readable at very small size, no body. BOTTOM RIGHT: completely empty transparent cell. All occupied cells contain exactly one sprite fully inside their cell with 10% margin, no dividers no labels no text no ground or shadow. These layers will be animated independently. Keep style faithful to reference; do not add details or extra particles.
